name: Dialog
description: A modal dialog that fades in a blurred backdrop and scales the panel up with a soft ease, with a title, description, body content and footer actions. Focus is trapped while open and restored to the trigger on close.
a11yNotes: Implements the WAI-ARIA dialog (modal) pattern: role="dialog" with aria-modal, aria-labelledby (title) and aria-describedby (description). Focus moves into the panel on open, Tab/Shift+Tab cycle inside it, Escape and backdrop click close it, and focus returns to the trigger. Body scroll is locked while open. The panel is portaled to document.body only after mount and copies the --mf-* theme variables from its trigger. Under prefers-reduced-motion the panel only fades.

defaultProps.title: Edit profile
defaultProps.description: Make changes to your profile here. Click save when you're done.
